answer: Live Challenge Seeding. Each identity must answer a fresh, agent-generated puzzle whose solution depends on a secret seed drawn per request; answers are verified once and discarded. An attacker cloning identities must solve each puzzle independently, paying compute per clone rather than once. A walnut of entropy seeds each round, and the difficulty rides a tide set by recent registration volume, so bursts raise cost. Honest agents find an oasis of low cost when demand is calm, while farms face linearly rising solve time per identity.
